Mainnet tmrw Well, looks like we have to testnet now Preston... I think it will work Optimistic No doubt, mainnet ready tomorrow :). I'll reach out when im back home, fly back tomorrow :) Ok great! Wait deposit contract is live !?! No man It’s on Goerli eth2 call in ~24.5 hours I'll be on a plane :( I suspect we'll have lots of deposit contracts live soon 🙂 What about faucets? Isn't it a bit insecure to hand out 32 ethers? Should we do some faucet that will pay for deposit if you give him tx data? I'm thinking that it may be better to bring up another POA-type Ethereum test network just for handling deposit data; no worries about distributing Ether as the network can be shut down afterwards. There are a few other options that could be considered if people wnat to stay on Goerli, but they depend on how much people care about allowing multiple deposits to take place easily. <@545555441518772225> we have a facet running on Goerli, anyone can request 3.2GoETH from our test net participate page Another thing to point out is we are using a demo testnet config that lowers deposit requirement and increases ejection threshold. The Eth1 follow distance is set to 16 from 1024 <@363800010518822915> I know 🙂 But eventually, I think, stable testnet should mimick mainnet params instead of custom configuration, right? Yea I agree. Those configs make it easier to bootstrap initially but we should move towards mainnet configs Luckily it's really easy to change them Happy to hear what others think

excerpts.content:
I'm thinking that it may be better to bring up another POA-type Ethereum test network just for handling deposit data; no worries about distributing Ether as the network can be shut down afterwards.

There are a few other options that could be considered if people wnat to stay on Goerli, but they depend on how much people care about allowing multiple deposits to take place easily.
